_note: Test customer type: Swedish building contractors. Product byggtid, pricing per_seat (per user per month, a minimum number of users). Fictional.
offer: Byggtid replaces paper timesheets on building sites: hours and materials logged per job on the phone, ready for payroll and invoicing.
product_info: Byggtid is a phone app where builders and electricians log hours, materials and photos per job. The office gets timesheets ready for payroll and invoicing the same day, and project managers see each job's hours against the quote. Works offline on site and exports to Fortnox and Visma.
tone: Plain, short and specific. No hype words and no exclamation marks. One clear ask. Max 120 words for a first email.

auto_close.standard_terms: List price, standard terms, no custom contract

annual.for: per user on a 12-month plan; at least 5 users

pricing.deal_policy: Per user. Discounts above 5% need an admin.
